# vårdbemanning.ai - Agent & Developer Infrastructure

Machine-readable overview of vårdbemanning.ai. We publish hourly framework-agreement
rates (SKR ramavtal 2026) for healthcare consultant roles across Swedish regions,
plus compensation analysis for the consultants themselves.

## Data access policy

Bulk enumeration and scraping are not permitted. We do not publish machine-readable
indexes of valid roles or locations. Query the capabilities below for the specific
role and location you need.

The customer price (what the region pays under the framework agreement) is public data.
The consultant's resulting compensation as a contractor or employee — and the margin
model behind it — is our product and is only available to signed-in users. It is never
included in public HTML, JSON-LD or API responses.

## Capabilities

- Look up the 2026 framework-agreement hourly customer price for a healthcare role in
  a given Swedish municipality.
- Explain how the customer price relates to a consultant's compensation, qualitatively,
  without publishing the margin constants.
- Browse curated role reports covering national rate levels, zones and negotiation context.
- Ask the on-site assistant free-text questions about rates, zones and historical call-offs.

## Entry points

- https://vardbemanning.ai/ — start page with the rate calculator and the assistant.
- https://vardbemanning.ai/faktasidor — directory of roles and locations.
- https://vardbemanning.ai/lon/{specialty_slug}/{city_slug} — customer price for one
  role in one municipality. Slugs follow Swedish role and municipality names, lowercase,
  diacritics folded (radiolog, anestesilakare, sjukskoterska / umea, stockholm, goteborg).
- https://vardbemanning.ai/sitemap.xml — the canonical set of public URLs.

Rate pages embed JSON-LD (schema.org/Occupation, Dataset, FAQPage) server-rendered in the
first HTML response, containing the public customer price only.

## Sources

Regional framework agreements (SKR ramavtal 2024/2026) only. Never SCB or
Medlingsinstitutet salary statistics for consultant rates.
